mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies over Harriet Park with a waxing gibbous moon, though we do have a moderate air quality alert with an index of 53. There are no visible ISS passes scheduled for our area tonight.

The City Clerk is looking for student artists to design the new I Voted stickers for the November election. Students in grades K through 12 can submit their original, non-AI designs by July 22. Winners will be chosen by community vote between July 28 and August 7.
For those looking to get out, Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can join Hop Haus for trivia or head to the Wisconsin Brewing Company for Quizmasters Trivia.

The Verona Police Department reported that on July 13, a passerby noticed a vehicle stuck on a large rock. The responding officer discovered the driver was operating the vehicle while intoxicated, resulting in an O-W-I arrest.
Today's flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl, which sounds like a fantastic treat. The restaurant is currently closed, but they will be open and ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
